rationale: C20 is the direct and extensive drafting template for the child. The child reproduces C20's two-part architecture and nearly the entire sequence of contracting authorities, delegation rules, contract definitions, modification powers, recordkeeping, nondiscrimination, assignment restrictions, required warranties, audit access, statutory limitations, labor-law coverage, and preservation clauses, while updating details and extending the machinery to additional agencies. C05 and C03 are also close antecedents for the child's Part II extension mechanism, but each supplies only an agency-specific instance of machinery already contained in C20.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Under such regulations, which shall be uniform to the extent practicable, as may be prescribed or approved by the Secretary of Defense: 1. The Department of Defense is authorized ... to enter into contracts and into amendments or modifications ... and to make advance payments thereon, without regard to the provisions of law relating to the making, performance, amendment, or modification of contracts
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Under such regulations, which shall be uniform to the extent practicable, as may be prescribed or approved by the Secretary of Defense: 1. The Department of Defense is authorized ... to enter into contracts and into amendments or modifications ... and to make advance, progress, and other payments thereon, without regard to the provisions of law relating to the making, performance, amendment, or modification of contracts.
shared_material.explanation: The opening regulatory formula and core contracting authorization are reproduced almost verbatim, with only limited substantive updates.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The contracts hereby authorized to be made shall include agreements of all kinds (whether in the form of letters of intent, purchase orders, or otherwise) for all types and kinds of property or services necessary, appropriate, or convenient for the national defense
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The contracts hereby authorized to be made include agreements of all kinds (whether in the form of letters of intent, purchase orders, or otherwise) for all types and kinds of things and services necessary, appropriate or convenient for the national defense
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive, detailed definition of permissible agreements and its ensuing list of defense property closely track C20.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Department of Defense may by agreement modify or amend or settle claims under contracts ... and may enter into agreements with contractors or obligors modifying or releasing accrued obligations of any sort, including accrued liquidated damages or liability under surety or other bonds.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Department of Defense may by agreement modify or amend or settle claims under contracts ... and may enter into agreements with contractors or obligors, modifying or releasing accrued obligations of any sort, including accrued liquidated damages or liability under surety or other bonds
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward the same unusually specific contract-adjustment machinery and language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Every contract entered into, amended, or modified pursuant to this order shall contain a warranty by the contractor in substantially the following terms: "The Contractor warrants that no person or selling agency has been employed or retained to solicit or secure this contract upon an agreement or understanding for a commission, percentage, brokerage, or contingent fee..."
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Every contract entered into, amended, or modified pursuant to this order shall contain a warranty by the contractor in substantially the following terms: The Contractor warrants that no person or selling agency has been employed or retained to solicit or secure this contract upon an agreement or understanding for a commission, percentage, brokerage, or contingent fee...
shared_material.explanation: The child reproduces C20's required contractor warranty essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Subject to the limitations and regulations contained in paragraphs 1 to 14 ... the head of each of the following-named agencies is authorized to perform or exercise as to his agency ... all the functions and authority vested by those paragraphs in the Secretaries mentioned therein
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The provisions of Part I of this order are hereby extended to the Department of Commerce; and, subject to the limitations and regulations contained in such part ... the Secretary of Commerce is authorized to perform and exercise, as to the Department of Commerce, all the functions and authority vested in and granted by Part I of this order to the Secretaries named therein
shared_material.explanation: The child's Part II generalizes C20's agency-extension provision from Commerce to a list of agencies while preserving its structure and operative phrasing.
